snippet.title: Fantasy Network - Summer Fest Trailer - DEMO OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
Try the demo here : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492100/Fantasy_Network/ 

Fantasy Network is a cartoonish action adventure "socialVania" game that features exploring, fighting, social networking and talent shows.

Coming on Steam and consoles in 2026.
